name: ANYFP

sources.title: Homepage — 'The human-checked AI index', 6,523 tools, 'Listing is free and reviewed by a human'
Submit your tool — free listing, 3-step form (Basics / About the tool / Media)
For makers — how listing works (linked from homepage and submit page)
Badge page (verified badge for claimed listings)

requirements: Product must be an AI tool; every submission is reviewed by a person before publishing
Full description must be at least 100 characters
At least one screenshot is mandatory (up to 4); logo upload required (PNG/JPG/WebP, up to 5 MB)
Key features list required — one per line, up to 8
preparation: Tool name, website URL, and one-line description
Category choice from 13 fixed options (Assistant, Audio, Business, Code, Design, Education, Gaming, Image, Lifestyle, Other, Productivity, Video, Writing)
Pricing model (Free / Freemium / Paid) and optional price note
Platform checkboxes (Web, iOS, Android, Desktop, API, Browser extension)
Logo file under 5 MB and 1–4 screenshots; optional YouTube demo URL
workflow: Open https://anyfp.com/submit (optionally use the 'Draft with AI' helper at /ai-draft first)
Step 1 Basics: name, URL, category, e-mail
Step 2 About the tool: one-line description, full description (>=100 chars), audience, problem solved, pricing, platforms, key features
Step 3 Media: upload logo and >=1 screenshot, optional video
Submit; human review 'usually within a couple of days'
After publication, claim the listing to edit anytime and display a Verified badge; owner can reply to reviews
watchFor: The submit page explicitly says 'no pay-to-rank' — there is no paid fast lane to accept instead
Full description field enforces a 100-character minimum client-side
E-mail field is required but never published — use an address you monitor for the review outcome
'Featured' placement exists on the site but how tools get featured is not explained on public pages
countsAsLive: Tool has a public detail page on anyfp.com (e.g. anyfp.com/<slug>) and appears in 'Recently verified' or its category listing
unknowns: Exact review SLA beyond 'usually within a couple of days'
Whether rejection reasons are communicated by e-mail
How the Featured slot is granted (editorial vs paid)
